INDEPENDENT VFX RESEARCH REFERENCE
Research reviewed through 13 October 2026

Purpose
This is an independent research input for later comparison and synthesis with a separately researched Claude report. It is not the final cross-model synthesis and does not implement a VFX designer agent. Its target task is to select, combine, time, place, recolour, scale, tune and review existing flipbooks and Roblox VFX parts.

Start here
- Independent_VFX_Research_Reference.json is the complete structured reference, with all twelve required outputs, supporting material, sources, claims and contradictions.
- Independent_VFX_Research_Reference.txt is the readable text version of the DOCX. Choose it or the structured reference as the main ingestion path to avoid ingesting the same content repeatedly.
- The numbered JSON files expose each output separately. The six requested tables also have CSV versions with the exact required headers and column order.
- source_register.json and source_register.csv identify provenance, dates, tiers, URLs and read scope.
- claim_ledger.json and claim_ledger.csv connect source claims to their context and limitations.
- row_provenance.json maps table rows to sources and claims without adding columns to the exact-format tables.
- effect_card_template.json holds a fillable machine template. Numeric nulls mean no chosen or supported value; null is never a production zero.
- supporting_reference.json contains safety and synchrony numbers, repetition guidance, kitbashing, performance and mobile testing, derived arithmetic, accessibility settings and destruction guidance.
- contradictions.json identifies unresolved or contextual disagreements that must survive later synthesis.

Evidence handling
A source tier is provenance, not an assurance that a number transfers to Roblox. Keep study, preprint, industry practice, spec and inference separate. A source can verify an engine property without proving that it feels good. All moment recipes and genre profiles are proposed inferences. Importance scores and phase durations remain unassigned when evidence does not establish them.

A reported 1–10 League importance exercise does not map automatically to brightness, size, duration or counts. Film exposure cadence is not game simulation rate. Published hit-stop frame observations must not be converted to milliseconds without their frame-rate context. Engine caps, upload maxima and tutorial values are not performance budgets.

Sources dated before 2020 are marked. Modern follow-up may qualify rather than replicate an older model. Catalog abstracts support metadata and stated scope only. The source registry contains aliases because separate sections sometimes used the same publication; count distinct URLs rather than source IDs as independent publications. No downloaded third-party PDFs, images or full articles are included.

Safety and uncertainty
Read the safety criteria in their original scope and version. WCAG visual-field area is not a whole-screen percentage; an analyzer pass is not a medical guarantee. Assess combined rendered output. Keep reduced-motion and reduced-flash alternatives without deleting essential gameplay meaning.

The CHI 2024 playtime inconsistency is retained and the unreconciled 10.8% claim is not adopted. Current Roblox documentation conflicts and living-spec caveats are explicit. Commercial Roblox case coverage remains a gap; official tutorials are examples of capability, not proof of shipped-game quality or mobile efficacy.

For the later synthesis
Compare claims and source versions, preserve null and contrary findings, and distinguish duplicated citations from independent corroboration. Do not turn an artist's single-project heuristic into a universal timing default. When evidence is missing, retain 'no number found' and use the proposed project tests rather than filling a plausible number.

Files use UTF-8. CSV files include a UTF-8 byte-order mark for spreadsheet compatibility. The manifest records file sizes and SHA-256 hashes for integrity. No implementation, production asset files or executable game scripts are supplied.
